title: Oven Roasted Spanish Peppadew Peppers Crema Catalana
description: A sweet and savory Spanish dessert featuring roasted Peppadew peppers and a creamy custard base, infused with the deep umami flavor of kombu cold extract. This dish is inspired by the traditional Catalan cream and is made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the Peppadew peppers on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let them cool, then peel off the skin and chop the flesh into small pieces.
In a medium saucepan, combine the cream, sugar, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs, lemon zest, and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the hot cream mixture to the egg mixture, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Stir in the chopped Peppadew peppers and kombu cold extract.
Pour the mixture into 6 small ramekins or cups and place them in a large baking dish.
Add hot water to the baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
